key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence enabled stronger perovskite reasoning and guided contact design for solar cells reaching 27.05% efficiency.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI could help engineers select interface materials and prioritize experiments to improve perovskite device efficiency and thermal stability.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 articles, linking strategies, controls and observations to mechanisms.
Adapt OpenPerov using structured evidence and refine selected responses with retrieved evidence.
Experimentally test an AI-selected K analogue against an expert-preferred Na analogue for self-assembled monolayer design.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; experimentally, devices using the selected contact reached 27.05% efficiency and retained 96.74% after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85°C.
watch_item: The reported dark thermal ageing test does not establish durability under continuous illumination or outdoor operating conditions.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
